spans.s: N. of a man, Rājat.
becoming, being (see अमुत्र-, आत्म- &c.)
भू—युक्ता f. a kind of palm, L.
भूय—त्व n. See ब्रह्म-भूय-त्व.
भूय—रूप mfn. prob. w.r. for उभय-रूप, Kap.
in comp. for भूयस्.
भूयः—पलायन n. fleeing once more, Kathās.
भूयः—संनिवृत्ति f. returning once more (see अ-भूयः-स्˚), Ragh.
भू॑यः—स्तन (भू॑यः-), mfn. having more teats than (abl.), ŚBr.
in comp. for भूयस्.
becoming (n. the act of becoming; see ब्रह्म-भ्˚)

‘becoming in a greater degree’ (in this meaning accord. to Pāṇ. vi, 4, 158 compar. of बहु) i.e. more, more numerous or abundant, greater, larger, mightier (also ‘much or many, very numerous or abundant’ &c.), RV. &c. &c.
abounding in, abundantly furnished with (instr. or comp.), Kathās.; Sāh.
(अस्), ind. (g. स्वर्-आदि) more, most, very much, exceedingly, RV. &c. &c.
still more, moreover, besides, further on GṛŚrS.; Up. &c. (also भूयस्या मात्रया, Divyāv.; पूर्वम्-भूयः, first-next, R.; आदौ-पश्चात्-भूयः, first-then-next, Prasaṅg.)
once more, again, anew, Mn.; MBh. &c. (also भूयो ऽपि, भूयश् चापि, भूयो भूयः and पुनर् भूयः)
भूयिष्ठ. See p. 763.
भूयश्—छन्दिक mfn. having a great desire for anything.
mostly, generally, usually, MBh.
once more, again, Hariv.; BhP.
(असा), ind. exceedingly, in a high degree, Kālid.
mostly, generally, as a rule, R.; Kathās. (cf. यद् भूयसा).
भू॑यस्—कर mfn. making or doing more, VS.
भू॑यस्—काम mfn. very desirous of anything (-ता f.), L.
भू॑यस्—काम—ता f.
भूयस्—कृ॑त् mfn. augmenting, increasing, TS.
भूयस्—कृ॑त् f. pl. N. of a partic. kind of brick, ĀpŚr.
भूयस्—तरम् or भूयस्—तराम्, ind. more, anew, again, R.
भूयस्—तरम् or भूयस्—तराम्, ind. more, anew, again, R.
भूयस्—त्व n. the becoming or being more or much, increase, preponderance, abundance, multitude, GṛŚrS.; Gaut.; Suśr.
great extent, Sarvad.
भूयस्—त्वेन (एन), ind. for the most part, mostly, L.
preponderant, superior, TāṇḍBr.
mf(आ)n. (accord. to Pāṇ. vi, 4, 158 superl. of बहु) most numerous or abundant or great or important, chief principal, RV. &c. &c.
(ifc. = having anything as chief part or ingredient, chiefly filled with or characterised by, nearly all, almost; cf. शूद्र-भ्˚, निर्वाण-भ्˚ &c.)
(अम्), ind. for the most part, mostly, chiefly, RV. &c. &c.
abundantly, numerously, R.
in the highest degree, very much, Ragh.
(एन), ind. mostly &c., MBh.
भूयिष्ठ—तर mfn. mostly consisting of (comp.), MBh.
भूयिष्ठ—भा॑ज् mfn. sharing principally, receiving most, TS.; ŚBr.; ĀpŚr.
भूयिष्ठ—शस् ind. in very large numbers, MBh.
in comp. for भूयस्.
भूयो—ऽक्षर mf(आ)n. (भूयस् + अक्षर) having more syllables, TāṇḍBr.
भूयो—ऽक्षर—तर mfn. id., AitBr.
भूयो—गुण mfn. ‘doubled’ and ‘having more virtues’, Naiṣ.
भूयो—दर्शन n. N. of wk.
भूयो—दर्शन—वाद m. N. of wk.
भूयो—ऽनागमन (भूयस् + अनागमन) n. non-return, Kathās.
भूयो—भर्तृ-समागम m. meeting again with a husband, ib.
भूयो—भाव m. increase, growth, progress, L.
भूयो—मात्र n. the greatest part, most of (gen.), Kauś.
भूयो—रुचि mfn. taking much delight in anything (-ता f.), L.
भूयो—रुचि—ता f.
भूयो—विद्य mfn. knowing more, more learned, Nir.
